info.title: AIS Maritime Intelligence Events
info.description: NATS JetStream contracts of AIS Maritime Intelligence v2 (spec section 7), generated from @darmawanweb/ais-its-contracts. Every message is a JSON event envelope; "data" follows the payload schema of its "type".

local.description: NATS with JetStream of the local development stack.

aisRaw.title: AIS_RAW
aisRaw.description: Normalized AIS reports published by the ais-ingestor. JetStream stream AIS_RAW: limits retention, max age 1 d.

x-ais-its-stream.name: AIS_RAW
x-ais-its-stream.description: Normalized AIS reports published by the ais-ingestor.

aisPosition.title: AIS_POSITION
aisPosition.description: Recorded positions partitioned by mmsi % 16 (ais.position.v1.<partition>.<mmsi>). JetStream stream AIS_POSITION: limits retention, max age 7 d.

fuelReading.title: FUEL
fuelReading.description: Fuel consumption readings published by telemetry. JetStream stream FUEL: limits retention, max age 30 d.

x-ais-its-stream.name: FUEL
x-ais-its-stream.description: Fuel consumption readings published by telemetry.

fleetVessel.title: FLEET
fleetVessel.description: Latest vessel snapshot per vessel (projection source for every service). JetStream stream FLEET: limits retention, max age ∞, keeps 1 message(s) per subject.

x-ais-its-stream.name: FLEET
x-ais-its-stream.description: Latest vessel snapshot per vessel (projection source for every service).

geoZone.title: GEO
geoZone.description: Latest zone snapshot per zone published by geo (projection source for safety and surveillance). JetStream stream GEO: limits retention, max age ∞, keeps 1 message(s) per subject.

x-ais-its-stream.name: GEO
x-ais-its-stream.description: Latest zone snapshot per zone published by geo (projection source for safety and surveillance).

safetyState.title: SAFETY
safetyState.description: Latest navigational safety state per vessel published by safety. JetStream stream SAFETY: limits retention, max age 7 d, keeps 1 message(s) per subject.

x-ais-its-stream.name: SAFETY
x-ais-its-stream.description: Latest navigational safety state per vessel published by safety.

ciiUpdated.title: EMISSION
ciiUpdated.description: Year-to-date CII updates published by emission. JetStream stream EMISSION: limits retention, max age 30 d.

x-ais-its-stream.name: EMISSION
x-ais-its-stream.description: Year-to-date CII updates published by emission.

alert.title: ALERTS
alert.description: Alerts raised by the safety and surveillance detectors (alert.v1.<alertType>.<mmsi>). JetStream stream ALERTS: limits retention, max age 90 d.

alertType.description: Alert type of the registry ALERT_TYPES or a future type (consumers accept unknown types).

x-ais-its-stream.name: ALERTS
x-ais-its-stream.description: Alerts raised by the safety and surveillance detectors (alert.v1.<alertType>.<mmsi>).

notifyEmail.title: NOTIFY
notifyEmail.description: Transactional e-mail requests (work queue). JetStream stream NOTIFY: workqueue retention, max age 7 d.

audit.title: AUDIT
audit.description: Audit records of every service, consumed by auth. JetStream stream AUDIT: limits retention, max age 30 d.

x-ais-its-stream.name: AUDIT
x-ais-its-stream.description: Audit records of every service, consumed by auth.

deadLetter.title: DLQ
deadLetter.description: Dead letters: messages that exceeded max_deliver, at dlq.<stream>.<consumer>. JetStream stream DLQ: limits retention, max age 14 d.

x-ais-its-stream.name: DLQ
x-ais-its-stream.description: Dead letters: messages that exceeded max_deliver, at dlq.<stream>.<consumer>.

telemetryMqtt.title: Device telemetry (core NATS)
telemetryMqtt.description: Core NATS subject of MQTT topic aisits/telemetry/<deviceId> (NATS MQTT gateway); not persisted in JetStream.

send-audit.recorded.v1.summary: Published by auth, fleet, ais-ingestor, ais-processor, telemetry, emission, geo, safety, surveillance, notification.

receive-ais-processor.summary: ais-processor: Enriches and records raw AIS reports.

receive-emission-positions.summary: emission: Builds voyage segments (fuel, CO2, CII) from positions.

receive-safety-positions.summary: safety: Feeds the navigational safety detectors (ews, collision).

receive-surveillance-positions.summary: surveillance: Feeds the surveillance detectors (transhipment, anomaly, dark, geofence, fishing).

receive-emission-fuel.summary: emission: Telemetry fuel readings for segment fuel estimation.

receive-emission-fleet.summary: emission: Vessel projection (mmsi → vesselId, orgId) of emission.

receive-safety-fleet.summary: safety: Vessel projection (mmsi → vesselId, orgId) of safety.

receive-surveillance-fleet.summary: surveillance: Vessel projection (mmsi → vesselId, orgId) of surveillance.

receive-notification-fleet.summary: notification: Vessel projection (mmsi → vesselId, orgId) of notification.

receive-telemetry-fleet.summary: telemetry: Vessel projection (mmsi → vesselId, orgId) of telemetry.

receive-ais-processor-fleet.summary: ais-processor: Vessel projection (mmsi → vesselId, orgId) of ais-processor.

receive-safety-zones.summary: safety: Zone projection with a spatial index (ZoneIndex) of safety.

receive-surveillance-zones.summary: surveillance: Zone projection with a spatial index (ZoneIndex) of surveillance.

receive-notification-alerts.summary: notification: Stores alerts in the inbox, applies alert rules and pushes them to clients.

receive-notification-email.summary: notification: Renders and sends transactional e-mails.

receive-auth-audit.summary: auth: Writes the central audit log.

receive-notification-positions.summary: notification: Realtime position fan-out to WebSocket tile and vessel rooms.

receive-notification-safety.summary: notification: Realtime safety:states / vessel:safety fan-out to tile and vessel rooms.

receive-notification-cii.summary: notification: Realtime cii:updated fan-out to organization rooms.

send-dead-letter.summary: Every durable consumer copies a message here after max_deliver deliveries, then acks it.

receive-telemetry-mqtt.summary: telemetry: Raw device JSON from MQTT topic aisits/telemetry/<deviceId> (NATS MQTT gateway).
